input: Book a private dining experience for mom's milestone birthday

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Private dining can mean a fully exclusive room, a semi-private section, or a chef's table — the type dramatically changes which venues to target and what to ask for.
The number of guests and their relationship to mom (close family only, friends, colleagues) affects room size, seating arrangements, and the tone of the event.
The city or neighborhood, and the exact date, determine which venues are available and how much lead time exists to secure a booking.
Budget per person or total spend sets the tier of restaurant to pursue and whether add-ons like a custom cake or wine pairing are feasible.
Mom's cuisine preferences, dietary restrictions, or dream-restaurant wishlist will narrow the shortlist far more than any other filter.
Knowing what would make this feel truly special — e.g., a personalised menu, live music, a surprise element — defines what 'done well' looks like beyond just securing a table.
Whether the user wants a curated shortlist of venues to choose from, or wants direct help contacting and booking a specific place, determines the immediate next action.

gold.taskTitle: Book private dining for mom's milestone birthday
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a private dining experience to celebrate mom's significant birthday milestone.

questions.title: What type of private dining setup do you have in mind?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a fully exclusive private room, a semi-private section, a chef's table, or a full restaurant buyout — as this determines which venues to target.

questions.title: How many guests will be attending the dinner?
questions.description: Establish the headcount to match the right room size and seating capacity at potential venues.

questions.title: What city or area should the restaurant be in?
questions.description: Pin down the location so the search can be narrowed to accessible, relevant venues.

questions.title: What is the target date for the birthday dinner?
questions.description: Identify the exact or preferred date to check availability and understand how much booking lead time is available.

questions.title: What is your overall budget for this experience?
questions.description: Determine the total spend or per-person budget to filter venues by price tier and assess feasibility of extras like wine pairings or a custom cake.

questions.title: Does mom have a favourite cuisine or any dietary restrictions?
questions.description: Capture food preferences and dietary needs to shortlist venues that will genuinely delight her.

questions.title: What one thing would make this dinner feel truly unforgettable?
questions.description: Identify the standout element — personalised menu, surprise toast, live music, floral decor — that defines success beyond just securing a reservation.
